statement: Graphics presets persist named selections and their revision. First-launch detection is a pure GPU/CPU description classifier. New revision-3 Low/Medium/High selections apply the approved revision-1 visual table; Ultra retains revision 2 and identical values and saved bytes. Saved revision-1 and revision-2 values and overrides remain intact until explicit reselection. Independent vsync and frame-cap choices remain in user.video and are included in resolved graphics. Settings UI and persistence regressions are registered; native execution and visual qualification remain pending.
